subject: Post-signature implementation: sprint matrix & initial MAP (Auraflow)
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@auraflow.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuraFlow Procurement <procurement@auraflow.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature implementation: sprint matrix & initial MAP (Auraflow)

Hi Priya / Redwood team,

Thanks again for getting the agreement over the finish line — excited to get started. Procurement has routed the signature to DocuSign; we expect countersign by EOD Thursday. Before that locks in, my team wanted to share a short list of must-haves we want captured in the mutual action plan embedded in the contract and to propose an initial post-signature sprint matrix. High level asks: 

- Canary pilot: 2-week guarded pilot with 2k daily active inference requests (rolling-window).
- Migration window: 72-hour cutover window (weekday preferred) with a nightly rollback snapshot.
- Training: two 90-minute train-the-trainer sessions + optional ops runbook review.
- Evaluations: acceptance criteria tied to latency P95 <= 220ms and token cost within 12% of forecast.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II summary, retention and audit log posture.

I've attached a short workbook (Auraflow-MAP-Questions.xlsx) with our internal checklist — please fill columns B/C with Redwood owners and expected dates. We're flexible on exact dates but aiming to start the canary in the week of June 12 (Auraflow timezone: PDT).

Can you confirm: 
1) Redwood owner for the canary ops run (who will be on the call day-of),
2) proposed cutover week options (we prefer June 26–30 as primary),
3) whether you can provide a staged rollback playbook by kickoff?

I'll loop in procurement separately but wanted to capture operational commitments now so we can align the MAP with the contract.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Head of Cloud Operations, AuraFlow
S: +1 415 555 0129

Attachments: Auraflow-MAP-Questions.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@auraflow.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature implementation: sprint matrix & initial MAP (Auraflow)

Sophie — great to hear and congrats to both teams. Quick responses inline below and a proposed internal cadence.

1) Redwood canary ops lead: Karthik Iyer will be lead for pilot operations and escalation. He'll be the day-of single point-of-contact and owns the KV-cache warmup + prefilling steps.

2) Cutover week: We can support a primary cutover in June 26–30 and a fallback week of July 10–14. For the 72-hour window, we recommend a Tuesday start (UTC-friendly) to maximize engineering availability.

3) Rollback playbook: We'll deliver an initial rollback runbook (draft) 5 business days prior to the canary start and a finalized playbook 48 hours before cutover.

Proposed sprint matrix (high-level):
- Week 0 (prep): access + credentials, SOC 2 evidence exchange, final MAP doc sign-off.
- Week 1 (canary): 14-day guarded pilot; daily sync (30m) with Aurora Ops and Redwood SRE; telemetry and eval gates at days 3/7/14.
- Week 3 (ramp): broaden traffic to staging subset, training sessions for 2 ops champions.
- Week 4 (cutover): migration weekend; 72-hour window; on-call rotation and rollback checkpoints.

On security evidence: we can share the SOC 2 Type II summary and retention policy excerpt by Wednesday morning. Priyom will coordinate with Security to redact PII where needed.

I'm attaching an initial MAP draft (RDW-MAP-Draft-priya.pdf) with owners filled for the items we own. If that looks ok, we'll add dates and produce the final MAP artifact to embed in the SOW.

Next steps / asks for you: fill out the attached checklist with Auraflow owners and confirm a preferred canary start date (week of June 12 vs June 19).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW-MAP-Draft-priya.pdf (pdf)

On Tue, May 21, 2028 at 4:18 PM Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sophie — great to hear and congrats to both teams. Quick responses inline below and a proposed internal cadence.

Thanks — the draft looks aligned. Two small adjustments:

- Canary: can we make the guarded pilot 10 business days instead of 14? Our internal release windows are tighter right now; a 10-day pilot with the same telemetry gates (days 3/7/10) will work.
- Training: we need one extra ops champion session (three trainers total) to cover our EMEA shift.

Procurement note: I initiated DocuSign and you should see AF-0427 in your queue (link below). There are two minor redline items on uptime SLA targets and an additional clause referencing audit log retention — procurement asked me to confirm acceptance or propose language by Thursday EOD.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/auraflow/AF-0427

I'll get AuraFlow owners filled in the workbook and return by Friday. If you can commit the rollback playbook draft by June 5, we should be in good shape to hit a canary start on June 19.

— Sophie
Sophie Lane
Head of Cloud Operations, AuraFlow
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: AuroraFlow MAP — owners & next steps

Karthik / Priyom / Marissa — quick actionable summary from the external thread: 

1) Canary pilot: target start June 19 (Auraflow asked for 10 business days). Karthik = pilot lead; set up daily 30m stand at 9:00 PDT day-of (calendar invite to follow).
2) Rollback playbook: draft due June 5 (Priyom to draft with Security input). Finalize 48 hours before cutover.
3) Training: schedule two 90-minute train-the-trainer + one extra session for EMEA shift (Marissa to coordinate materials and trainer roster).
4) SOC 2 evidence: Priyom to redact and drop SOC 2 summary to Sophie by Wed morning.
5) Contract items: procurement has two redlines (SLA uptime language + audit log retention). I will review and propose clause language by Thursday EOD.

Please reply with any blockers. Karthik — I gave you ownership of warmup/prefill tasks and the on-call rota for the cutover window. Let's confirm runbook template by Monday.

Thanks — Priya
